key: "Ticket Purchase- Regions outside of Reborn City:
en: "Ticket Purchase- Regions outside of Reborn City:
ja: 「チケット購入――リボーンシティ以外の地方:

key: All tickets currently sold out.
en: All tickets currently sold out.
ja: 現在、すべてのチケットは売り切れです。

key: Please check back later."
en: Please check back later."
ja: また後で確認してください」

key: Promotional user authorized.
en: Promotional user authorized.
ja: 特別利用者として認証されました。

key: Limited access available to: Tourmaline Station
en: Limited access available to: Tourmaline Station
ja: 利用可能な限定区間: トルマリン駅

key: Would you like to purchase a ticket?"
en: Would you like to purchase a ticket?"
ja: チケットを購入しますか?」

key: Employees only beyond this area, please.
en: Employees only beyond this area, please.
ja: この先は関係者以外立入禁止です。

key: Hey there.
en: Hey there.
ja: どうも。

key: If you've never ridden with us before, perhaps you've never seen the Grandview Station in action.
en: If you've never ridden with us before, perhaps you've never seen the Grandview Station in action.
ja: まだ利用したことがないなら、グランドビュー駅が稼働しているところを見たことがないかもしれませんね。

key: It may not look like much in rest like this, but each of these platforms behind me is a marvel of engineering.
en: It may not look like much in rest like this, but each of these platforms behind me is a marvel of engineering.
ja: 止まっているとこう見えても、この後ろのホームひとつひとつが工学の粋を集めたものなんですよ。

key: A dozen more are stored below us, each of them able to rotate and shift aside to make room for as many vehicles as we might need to store.
en: A dozen more are stored below us, each of them able to rotate and shift aside to make room for as many vehicles as we might need to store.
ja: この下にはさらに十数基が格納されていて、それぞれが回転してずれることで、必要な数の車両を収める余地を作れるんです。

key: When it's time for departure, the proper platform rotates out to the exit gate.
en: When it's time for departure, the proper platform rotates out to the exit gate.
ja: 出発の時間になると、該当のホームが回転して出口ゲートへと出ていきます。

key: And when a train comes in and everyone disembarks, it can be kept here or below without any hassle at all!
en: And when a train comes in and everyone disembarks, it can be kept here or below without any hassle at all!
ja: 列車が到着して全員が降りたら、そのままここか下に格納できて、まったく手間がかからないんです!

key: In this way, the Grandview Station is able to maintain a high-capacity transportation network with just a fraction of the space of other regions' stations.
en: In this way, the Grandview Station is able to maintain a high-capacity transportation network with just a fraction of the space of other regions' stations.
ja: こうしてグランドビュー駅は、他の地方の駅よりもずっと少ない敷地面積で、大容量の交通網を維持しているんですよ。

key: "Ticket Purchase within Reborn City:
en: "Ticket Purchase within Reborn City:
ja: 「チケット購入――リボーンシティ内:

key: Currently unavailable.
en: Currently unavailable.
ja: 現在ご利用いただけません。

key: "Ticket Purchase within Reborn City"
en: "Ticket Purchase within Reborn City"
ja: 「チケット購入――リボーンシティ内」

key: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
en: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
ja: チケットを購入しますか? \ch[321,-1,コガネ駅,アイビーライン駅,サンセット駅,ヘザーヒル駅,ピオニー駅,キングスベリー駅,シャンティポート駅]

key: Hello!
en: Hello!
ja: こんにちは!

key: You see this beauty here?
en: You see this beauty here?
ja: この美しい車両、見えます?

key: This is the first in a line of new trains we'll be rolling out across the city once we just secure the remaining funds for it.
en: This is the first in a line of new trains we'll be rolling out across the city once we just secure the remaining funds for it.
ja: 残りの資金さえ確保できれば、街中に投入していく新型車両の第一号なんです。

key: The long-awaited 9R000 series...
en: The long-awaited 9R000 series...
ja: 待望の9R000系……

key: These babies are clean, lightning fast, and will take everyone to stations all across Reborn City faster than they can say 'modern locomotives!'
en: These babies are clean, lightning fast, and will take everyone to stations all across Reborn City faster than they can say 'modern locomotives!'
ja: こいつらはクリーンで超高速、「近代機関車」なんて言う間もなく、リボーンシティ中の駅までみんなを運んでくれます!

key: Look forward to it soon!
en: Look forward to it soon!
ja: 近日中にご期待ください!

key: It's about time this place got back underway!
en: It's about time this place got back underway!
ja: この場所がようやく再稼働する頃合いだ!

key: Now that it's an option again, you can bet I'll be traveling all over the place.
en: Now that it's an option again, you can bet I'll be traveling all over the place.
ja: また選べるようになったからには、あちこち旅して回るに決まってるさ。

key: I got a bucket list to finish, you know!
en: I got a bucket list to finish, you know!
ja: やり残したことリストを片付けないとな!

key: Hrmm...
en: Hrmm...
ja: うーむ……

key: Perhaps it's because we've only recently opened, but there's hardly any trains scheduled to come in.
en: Perhaps it's because we've only recently opened, but there's hardly any trains scheduled to come in.
ja: 開通したばかりだからか、来る予定の列車がほとんどないんだよなあ。

key: Now that this place is restored, I just have to hope that my son will come back to me.
en: Now that this place is restored, I just have to hope that my son will come back to me.
ja: ここが復興した今、あとは息子が戻ってきてくれるのを願うだけだ。

key: I like trains!
en: I like trains!
ja: 電車すき!

key: I wanna ride on one!
en: I wanna ride on one!
ja: 1台乗りたい!

key: I wanna ride on two!
en: I wanna ride on two!
ja: 2台乗りたい!

key: At the same time!
en: At the same time!
ja: 同時に!

key: Goodness, I seem to have dropped my ticket. Can't be late!
en: Goodness, I seem to have dropped my ticket. Can't be late!
ja: あら、チケットを落としちゃったみたい。遅刻できないのに!

key: Zzz...
en: Zzz...
ja: Zzz……

key: 7:15 to Goldenrod. 7:25 to Peony. Tuesday. 7:25 to Ivyline.
en: 7:15 to Goldenrod. 7:25 to Peony. Tuesday. 7:25 to Ivyline.
ja: 7時15分、コガネ行き。7時25分、ピオニー行き。火曜日。7時25分、アイビーライン行き。

key: Wednesday. 7:25 to Shantyport. 7:30 to Heatherhill. 7:40 to Goldenrod.
en: Wednesday. 7:25 to Shantyport. 7:30 to Heatherhill.  7:40 to Goldenrod.
ja: 水曜日。7時25分、シャンティポート行き。7時30分、ヘザーヒル行き。7時40分、コガネ行き。

key: Monday. 7:45 to Kingsbury. Tuesday. 7:45 to Ivyline. Wednesday. 7:25 to Sunset. Click.
en: Monday. 7:45 to Kingsbury. Tuesday. 7:45 to Ivyline.  Wednesday. 7:25 to Sunset. Click.
ja: 月曜日。7時45分、キングスベリー行き。火曜日。7時45分、アイビーライン行き。水曜日。7時25分、サンセット行き。カチッ。

key: Hello! I'm with Reborn Construction Company!
en: Hello! I'm with Reborn Construction Company!
ja: こんにちは! リボーン建設の者です!

key: After just completing our last major product, in the revitalized Railnet, we're raring to hire up and take on even grander designs!
en: After just completing our last major product, in the revitalized Railnet, we're raring to hire up and take on even grander designs!
ja: 再生した地下鉄道網という前回の大事業を完成させたばかりで、さらに壮大な計画に向けて、今まさに増員したいところなんです!

key: If you or anyone you know is looking for a hands-on career to shape the future of this city, please apply!
en: If you or anyone you know is looking for a hands-on career to shape the future of this city, please apply!
ja: あなたやお知り合いで、この街の未来を作る実践的な仕事を探している方がいれば、ぜひご応募ください!

key: ADRIENN: \PN! My favorite champion!
en: ADRIENN: \PN! My favorite champion!
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN! お気に入りのチャンピオン!

key: I'm grateful you could make it, and you're just in time.
en: I'm grateful you could make it, and you're just in time.
ja: 来てくれて助かったわ、それにちょうどいいタイミングね。

key: I was just discussing the particulars with the chief here.
en: I was just discussing the particulars with the chief here.
ja: ちょうど、こちらの隊長と細かい話をしていたところなの。

key: CHIEF: Allow me to summarize once more.
en: CHIEF: Allow me to summarize once more.
ja: 隊長: もう一度、要点をまとめさせてください。

key: Two of your compatriots recently unearthed a couple of unique artifacts.
en: Two of your compatriots recently unearthed a couple of unique artifacts.
ja: あなたの仲間の二人が、最近、珍しい遺物を二つ発掘しました。

key: But not too unique-- they were recognized:
en: But not too unique-- they were recognized:
ja: とはいえ、それほど珍しいわけでもなく――正体はすぐにわかりました。

key: The Red Orb and Blue Orb.
en: The Red Orb and Blue Orb.
ja: レッドオーブとブルーオーブです。

key: We're aware of what happened in Hoenn with these items...
en: We're aware of what happened in Hoenn with these items...
ja: これらのアイテムがホウエンで引き起こしたことは、私たちも承知しています……

key: And I think I speak for everyone when I say that Reborn has had enough of world-ending disaster!
en: And I think I speak for everyone when I say that Reborn has had enough of world-ending disaster!
ja: リボーンは世界を滅ぼしかねない災厄にはもうたくさんだと、皆を代表して言わせてもらいます!

key: We've put all that behind us!
en: We've put all that behind us!
ja: そういったことはすべて過去のものにしたはずです!

key: ADRIENN: At least, I dearly hope so...
en: ADRIENN: At least, I dearly hope so...
ja: アドリエンヌ: 少なくとも、心からそう願っているわ……

key: CHIEF: We want none of it!
en: CHIEF: We want none of it!
ja: 隊長: あんなものは二度とごめんです!

key: So I've taken the liberty of contacting some foreign experts, and we've arranged to have the orbs safely contained elsewhere.
en: So I've taken the liberty of contacting some foreign experts, and we've arranged to have the orbs safely contained elsewhere.
ja: そこで、勝手ながら海外の専門家に連絡を取り、オーブを安全に他所で保管する手配を整えました。

key: All that's left is to ship them there.
en: All that's left is to ship them there.
ja: あとはそこへ輸送するだけです。

key: ADRIENN: That's where you come in.
en: ADRIENN: That's where you come in.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そこであなたの出番よ。

key: We think the shipment's been compromised.
en: We think the shipment's been compromised.
ja: 輸送の情報が漏れている可能性があるの。

key: Some information regarding it was leaked, and--
en: Some information regarding it was leaked, and--
ja: それに関する情報が漏れてしまって――

key: In short, it's almost certain someone is trying to steal the orbs already.
en: In short, it's almost certain someone is trying to steal the orbs already.
ja: つまり、すでに誰かがオーブを盗もうとしているのはほぼ間違いないわ。

key: We'd like you to take the train ride abroad and make sure the orbs reach their destination safely.
en: We'd like you to take the train ride abroad and make sure the orbs reach their destination safely.
ja: あなたに列車で海外まで同行してもらって、オーブが無事に目的地に届くのを見届けてほしいの。

key: CHIEF: With a champion as beautiful and powerful as you, I'm sure no one will dare try anything!
en: CHIEF: With a champion as beautiful and powerful as you, I'm sure no one will dare try anything!
ja: 隊長: あなたのように美しく強いチャンピオンがいれば、誰も手を出そうとはしないでしょう!

key: With the champion on board, no one will dare try anything!
en: With the champion on board, no one will dare try anything!
ja: チャンピオンが乗っていれば、誰も手を出そうとはしないでしょう!

key: ADRIENN: I know playing security isn't exactly the most glamorous, but I don't think anyone wants to risk an incident with, say, Azurine Lake drying up or something...
en: ADRIENN: I know playing security isn't exactly the most glamorous, but I don't think anyone wants to risk an incident with, say, Azurine Lake drying up or something...
ja: アドリエンヌ: 警備役なんて、それほど華やかな仕事じゃないのはわかっているけど、例えばアズリン湖が干上がるみたいな事態を、誰も望んでいないと思うの……

key: With any luck, it'll be an uneventful trip there and back.
en: With any luck, it'll be an uneventful trip there and back.
ja: 運が良ければ、行き帰りとも何事もない旅になるはずよ。

key: You could even think of it as a vacation!
en: You could even think of it as a vacation!
ja: 休暇だと思ってくれてもいいくらいだわ!

key: CHIEF: I hate to rush, but I believe we are short on time...
en: CHIEF: I hate to rush, but I believe we are short on time...
ja: 隊長: 急かすようで申し訳ありませんが、そろそろ時間が……

key: ADRIENN: Right-- since the original shipment was compromised, the Chief arranged to sneak it on board a passenger train early.
en: ADRIENN: Right-- since the original shipment was compromised, the Chief arranged to sneak it on board a passenger train early.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね――もともとの輸送計画が漏れていたから、隊長が手配して、早めに旅客列車にこっそり積み込んだの。

key: CHIEF: Our hope is that the change in operation will be inconspicuous enough to escape the notice of whomever the information was leaked to.
en: CHIEF: Our hope is that the change in operation will be inconspicuous enough to escape the notice of whomever the information was leaked to.
ja: 隊長: 運用を変更したことで、情報が漏れた相手の目をかいくぐれることを願っています。

key: And by the time they find out-- too late!
en: And by the time they find out-- too late!
ja: 気づいたときには――もう手遅れというわけです!

key: ADRIENN: Your ticket and boarding is already arranged as well.
en: ADRIENN: Your ticket and boarding is already arranged as well.
ja: アドリエンヌ: あなたのチケットと乗車の手配はもう済んでいるわ。

key: The Chief will be going with you as well-- he'll show you to the storage car and keep an eye on the passengers during the mission.
en: The Chief will be going with you as well-- he'll show you to the storage car and keep an eye on the passengers during the mission.
ja: 隊長も一緒に行くから――保管車両まで案内して、任務中は乗客にも目を配ってくれるはずよ。

key: CHIEF: Yes, yes!
en: CHIEF: Yes, yes!
ja: 隊長: はい、はい!

key: Together, we'll keep both these orbs and our region safe!
en: Together, we'll keep both these orbs and our region safe!
ja: 力を合わせて、このオーブたちも私たちの地方も守り抜きましょう!

key: But the clock is ever-ticking-- let us be off at once!
en: But the clock is ever-ticking-- let us be off at once!
ja: しかし時は待ってくれません――今すぐ出発しましょう!

key: ADRIENN: Are you ready to leave right away?
en: ADRIENN: Are you ready to leave right away?
ja: アドリエンヌ: すぐに出発する準備はいい?

key: ADRIENN: Good luck, \PN! Safe journeys!
en: ADRIENN: Good luck, \PN! Safe journeys!
ja: アドリエンヌ: 幸運を、\PN! 道中気をつけて!

key: ADRIENN: Well hurry, hurry up!
en: ADRIENN: Well hurry, hurry up!
ja: アドリエンヌ: ほら、急いで、急いで!

key: We can only hold the train for so long!
en: We can only hold the train for so long!
ja: 列車をいつまでも止めておけるわけじゃないのよ!

key: ADRIENN: ...So, let me get this straight.
en: ADRIENN: ...So, let me get this straight.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……つまり、こういうことね。

key: The Chief was an imposter,
en: The Chief was an imposter,
ja: 隊長は偽者で、

key: The train was grounded in the desert,
en: The train was grounded in the desert,
ja: 列車は砂漠で立ち往生して、

key: The Red Orb was stolen,
en: The Red Orb was stolen,
ja: レッドオーブは盗まれて、

key: The thief got away,
en: The thief got away,
ja: 犯人は逃げて、

key: \PN suffered head trauma,
en: \PN suffered head trauma,
ja: \PNは頭に大けがをして、

key: And an entire pocket of New World space was completely destroyed in an explosion so intense that tremors were felt through the entire desert and city?
en: And an entire pocket of New World space was completely destroyed in an explosion so intense that tremors were felt through the entire desert and city?
ja: そして新世界の一角がまるごと吹き飛ぶほどの大爆発が起きて、その揺れは砂漠中、街中にまで届いた、と?

key: JULIA: Yep, that about sums it up!
en: JULIA: Yep, that about sums it up!
ja: ジュリア: うん、だいたいそんな感じ!

key: ADRIENN: ...
en: ADRIENN: ...
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……

key: JULIA: In my defense, I was left unattended with Terra for more than thirty seconds.
en: JULIA: In my defense, I was left unattended with Terra for more than thirty seconds.
ja: ジュリア: 弁解させてもらうと、テラと二人きりで30秒以上も放っておかれたんだよ。

key: ADRIENN: ...This is really going to put a damper on our relationship, isn't it?
en: ADRIENN: ...This is really going to put a damper on our relationship, isn't it?
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……これ、私たちの関係にかなり水を差しそうね。

key: TERRA: Juju an' I got it on like daaaaaaaaayum ;)
en: TERRA: Juju an' I got it on like daaaaaaaaayum ;)
ja: テラ: ジュジュとあたしマジやばいくらい盛り上がっちゃったし;)

key: ADRIENN: How did you even cause a chemical explosion in the New World with only a giant mallet, four dozen rubber ducks, and a half-eaten Rare Candy?
en: ADRIENN: How did you even cause a chemical explosion in the New World with only a giant mallet, four dozen rubber ducks, and a half-eaten Rare Candy?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 巨大なハンマーと、アヒルのおもちゃ48個と、食べかけのふしぎなアメだけで、新世界で化学爆発なんて、一体どうやって起こしたの?

key: SANDY: And where did you even get all those rubber ducks?!
en: SANDY: And where did you even get all those rubber ducks?!
ja: サンディ: というか、そのアヒルのおもちゃ、どこで全部手に入れたの?!

key: JULIA: Trust me, you don't wanna know.
en: JULIA: Trust me, you don't wanna know.
ja: ジュリア: 知らないほうがいいって。

key: SANDY: Yes, I do!
en: SANDY: Yes, I do!
ja: サンディ: ううん、知りたい!

key: TERRA: no u dont ;)
en: TERRA: no u dont ;)
ja: テラ: いや知りたくないし;)

key: SANDY: No, I don't!
en: SANDY: No, I don't!
ja: サンディ: そうだね、知りたくない!

key: ADRIENN: Julia, weren't you being evacuated to the recovery train anyway?
en: ADRIENN: Julia, weren't you being evacuated to the recovery train anyway?
ja: アドリエンヌ: ジュリア、そもそもあなたは救助列車に避難させられていたはずじゃなかった?

key: How did you even get caught up in this?
en: How did you even get caught up in this?
ja: 一体どうやってこんなことに巻き込まれたの?

key: JULIA: Oh, it's simple!
en: JULIA: Oh, it's simple!
ja: ジュリア: ああ、簡単だよ!

key: The guy in the officer hat said "This way, please!" so I just went the other way!
en: The guy in the officer hat said "This way, please!" so I just went the other way!
ja: 帽子をかぶった係員が「こちらへどうぞ!」って言うから、逆方向に行っただけ!

key: ADRIENN: But why--
en: ADRIENN: But why--
ja: アドリエンヌ: でもどうして――

key: No, nevermind, forget it...
en: No, nevermind, forget it...
ja: いえ、いいわ、忘れて……

key: It's not worth it...
en: It's not worth it...
ja: 聞くだけ無駄ね……

key: SANDY: I saw you dip out and followed you!
en: SANDY: I saw you dip out and followed you!
ja: サンディ: あなたが抜け出すのを見かけて、ついていったの!

key: I would've gotten there sooner but I tripped on a space rock and had to free fall for a while.
en: I would've gotten there sooner but I tripped on a space rock and had to free fall for a while.
ja: もっと早く着けたはずなんだけど、宇宙の岩につまずいて、しばらく落下することになっちゃって。

key: ADRIENN: Well, it's a good thing you did.
en: ADRIENN: Well, it's a good thing you did.
ja: アドリエンヌ: まあ、そうしてくれて良かったわ。

key: If you hadn't, you would've just been caught in the damage too.
en: If you hadn't, you would've just been caught in the damage too.
ja: そうしなければ、あなたも被害に巻き込まれていたはずだもの。

key: You're all incredibly lucky that Sandy was able to recover you from the New World despite the destruction.
en: You're all incredibly lucky that Sandy was able to recover you from the New World despite the destruction.
ja: あの崩壊の中、サンディがあなたたちを新世界から連れ戻せたのは、信じられないくらいの幸運よ。

key: Goodness, when Sandy is the responsible one... What's this come to...
en: Goodness, when Sandy is the responsible one...  What's this come to...
ja: まったく、サンディが一番しっかりしてる側だなんて……どうなってるのかしら……

key: SANDY: Hey, I'm super responsible!
en: SANDY: Hey, I'm super responsible!
ja: サンディ: ちょっと、わたしすっごくしっかりしてるよ!

key: ADRIENN: Responsible for a lot of problems, maybe!
en: ADRIENN: Responsible for a lot of problems, maybe!
ja: アドリエンヌ: 問題を起こす方の「責任」ならたくさんありそうね!

key: SANDY: I've never caused a problem in my life!
en: SANDY: I've never caused a problem in my life!
ja: サンディ: 今まで一度も問題なんて起こしたことないもん!

key: JULIA: Me neither!
en: JULIA: Me neither!
ja: ジュリア: アタシもだよ!

key: TERRA: i caused ur mom problems last nite lol
en: TERRA: i caused ur mom problems last nite lol
ja: テラ: きのうの夜あんたのママに問題おこしたけどw

key: ADRIENN: \PN, did we have to bring her back?
en: ADRIENN: \PN, did we have to bring her back?
ja: アドリエンヌ: \PN、彼女を連れ戻す必要、本当にあったのかしら?

key: ADRIENN: But why?
en: ADRIENN: But why?
ja: アドリエンヌ: というか、なんで?

key: TERRA: awhhh, shux.
